filters.title: Filters and performance
filters.description:
Turn on Enabled to use these features. Optional features start off.

Entity filtering sends only the entities your selected dashboards need. Registry filtering also shortens entity and device lists; turn it off if an editor is missing choices.

Visible-first graphs loads on-screen graphs first. Off-screen graphs load later, or immediately when you scroll to them. Pause animations during loading restores animations automatically.

Resource filtering skips optional card files you have not selected. Review Card files before enabling it. Reload the browser page after changing resource choices or comparing graph loading.

extra_entities.title: Extra entities
extra_entities.description: Add entities a card needs but Loona did not find, or entities needed on other pages using these accounts.

rules.title: Advanced entity rules
rules.description: Include an entity type such as light, individual entities, or a pattern such as sensor.*. Saved patterns remain available. Exclusions override inclusions and may leave cards without data. Loona always keeps its own controls and statistics.

compatibility.title: A Loona feature is unavailable
compatibility.description: Your Home Assistant version or another integration prevents Loona from using a feature. The affected feature is off; Home Assistant handles its requests normally. Check Loona diagnostics for the affected feature and supported versions. After reloading Loona, reload your browser pages.

scope.title: Loona is sending all entities
scope.description: Loona could not build a reliable entity list for your dashboards. Entity and registry filtering are temporarily paused, even if their switches are on. In Loona settings, check that your selected dashboards and accounts still exist. Save automatically generated dashboards. Unsupported templates or auto-entities rules can also prevent a complete scan. Loona resumes filtering when the scan succeeds. Download diagnostics to see what failed.

exclusion.title: An excluded entity is used by a dashboard
exclusion.description: A rule removes an entity that a dashboard card uses. The card may show missing or incorrect data. Open Advanced entity rules in Loona settings and remove that exclusion, or turn off Enabled to send all entities.

resources.title: Check which card files Loona loads
resources.description:
Resource filtering is on. Loona cannot confirm every file your dashboards may need, or a saved file is no longer registered. This warning does not mean a card is broken.

Open Card files in Loona settings. Files Loona knows are needed stay enabled. Check any additional files you need. If everything works, you can leave your choices as they are.

If a card or icon is missing, turn off Resource filtering and reload the browser page. You can then enable it again with the missing file checked.
